stages.headline: A light ray reflects from a mirror so that the angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection.
stages.headlineEnglish: A light ray reflects from a mirror so that the angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection.

stages.headline: A corner reflector is two mirrors at a right angle; after two reflections any ray returns parallel to its original direction.
stages.headlineEnglish: A corner reflector is two mirrors at a right angle; after two reflections any ray returns parallel to its original direction.

stages.headline: Proof: since ∠1 + ∠2 = 90° (acute angles of a right triangle), the co-interior angles of the incoming and outgoing rays sum to 180°, so they are parallel.
stages.headlineEnglish: Proof: since ∠1 + ∠2 = 90° (acute angles of a right triangle), the co-interior angles of the incoming and outgoing rays sum to 180°, so they are parallel.
